dogecoin.text: @realnedcolletti I know you aren't the GM but if you were the GM would you sign Manny Machado? The guy is a stud. He is carrying the Dodgers offensively right now. Saeger? Not a future hall of famer. Manny...Future HOF material. He should stay in my opinion. Best SS in the League
@BuildLinval @WISN_Watson Okay, but watch his frosty the snowman pose. He poses. With a strong fast, major leaguer wearing cleats. Clear out of the way.

@dfruc5 @PitcherList wish I had clips from games 1-3. Aguilar does this every time. It gets worse when it is the third out. He sort of leans into the runners. I was frustrated watching this in a game and I even yelled out, run him over, Clearly he is a tank and this would not be pretty. But still..

@thatgirlondeck Look at the video again. see the seconds and count down. 6, 5,4,3....about 3.5 seconds frozen after the catch. Who teaches that? Get out of the way! They always taught me that when I played first base....because...you never know. He won't do it again I bet.

@dfruc5 @PitcherList Safety first. Get out of the way.
Wouldn't you teach that to your first baseman, 2B and catchers for safety reasons? Why is he standing there. He almost seems to be leaning back into the runner at times.

@markmulder20 What are you mad about Mulder? You know that if this happened and you were pitching you would go after Manny in his next at bat and bean him. Am I right? Does that make you a dirty player too? Aguilar needs to get the hell out of the way and stop posing after the catch.

@MrBrianKenny In his defense. I have never seen a first baseman pose like that after he catches it. You have a Strong major league athlete with metal cleats barreling down on you, get out of the way big boy! That's pretty basic. Safety first.

@dodgers_randi He is posing for a picture. Who does that? You have a strong athlete with metal cleats barreling down on you. get the hell out of the way. Bet he doesn't leave his foot there anymore. Should have learned that in little league. Safety first.

@jimrome Rome is burning . Shut up. A hard slide, And a 1st baseman that won't get out of the way once he catches it? I mean c'mon who coached you in little league Aguilar? Get the hell out of the way once you make the out.

@PitcherList I noticed Aguilar does this every time. He stays in the runner's path. Picked up on that since gm 1. On outs # 3 he even catches the ball as he did here & even leans into the runners as they pass him by. Gotta move out the way n stop being cute w. pose. Bet he wont do it again

@Jared_Carrabis In defense of all runners, I noticed that Aguilar was leaning into the runners on 3rd outs a bit too close for comfort. I even thought of the possibility of a collision since he was not clearing out. I didn't expect this but I bet Aguilar will move out of the way.
@Jared_Carrabis I take it you don't like Manny?

@AJontheguitar STF Door. Manny is the best hitter for the Dodgers. Quit Whining Dodger Fans. Right now he leads in hits, doubles and RBIs and HRs in these playoffs. Without Manny we would have been out already. Dodgers should pay him. Saeger has nothing on Manny.

@PAGMETER I agree...He has been leaning into towards the runners especially on our number 3. Get the hell out of the way big boy. Make the out and move the foot. Good teaching point to kids playing first base or any base for that matter. Always protect yourself.

@Dodgers Quit whining about Manny Machado. Focus on the good things. He is the only offense you have right now. Leads the team in hits, doubles and RBI's in the post season. Where are the rest of the bats?
